title: The Cake That Never Got Smaller

breakdown.title: The Cake That Never Got Smaller
breakdown.logline: In a black-and-white memory of grandma's kitchen, a ringing phone and a shrinking room trap the dreamer as a child while the cake is cut forever.

colours.value: black and white, like an old film with scratches

breakdown.world_logic: The dream looks like an old black-and-white film. The cake never gets smaller no matter how many slices are cut. The kitchen shrinks around the dreamer, and the dreamer becomes a child again. Nobody reacts to the ringing phone.

landmarks.value: checked floor, big round clock on the wall, table, doorway, phone on the wall with long curly cord; color/style black and white like an old film with scratches

appearance.value: cake on the table, never gets smaller despite being cut
old kind with a long curly cord on the wall, ringing

moments.action: The dreamer stands in grandma's kitchen, black and white like an old film with scratches, watching grandma cut a cake at the table while uncle Ray leans in the doorway smoking.
moments.looks_at: the table with the cake, grandma cutting, uncle Ray in doorway
moments.visual_point: the black-and-white kitchen with the dreamer, grandma, and uncle Ray
moments.dream: the scene looks like an old black-and-white film with scratches

moments.action: Grandma calmly cuts the cake, slice after slice, but the cake never gets smaller.
moments.visual_point: the knife slicing into the cake that remains unchanged
moments.dream: the cake never gets smaller no matter how many slices are cut

moments.action: The old phone on the wall with the long curly cord starts ringing. Nobody answers it; grandma keeps cutting.
moments.dream: the phone rings but nobody reacts

moments.action: The kitchen starts getting smaller around the dreamer. The dreamer feels unable to move.
moments.dream: the kitchen shrinks around the dreamer

moments.action: The dreamer looks down and sees they are little again, wearing the red cardigan (which appears gray).
moments.looks_at: their own small body and the gray cardigan
moments.visual_point: the dreamer as a child in the cardigan
moments.dream: the dreamer becomes a child again

moments.action: The dreamer just stands there, unable to move, while the phone is still ringing.
moments.looks_at: the dreamer standing still, phone ringing in background
moments.visual_point: the dreamer frozen, phone still ringing
moments.dream: the phone rings on without being answered

words: it was weird, everything was black and white like an old film with scratches on it
yeah exactly, even the red cardigan was in black and white, which was strange because I remember it being red
I was in my grandma's kitchen, the one from when I was little, with the checked floor and the big round clock
I was just watching my grandma cut a cake at the table, and my uncle Ray was leaning in the doorway smoking
she looked calm, just focused on the knife, slice after slice but the cake never got smaller
the phone started ringing, the old kind with a long curly cord on the wall
nobody answered it, she kept cutting, and the kitchen started getting smaller around us
I felt like I couldn't move, and when I looked down I was little again, wearing that red cardigan
I don't remember how it felt, just that I was wearing it
nothing, I just stood there, and the phone was still ringing when I woke up
the black and white and the cake that never got smaller
the clock, the big round one on the wall
that's right, but the clock wasn't ringing or anything, just the phone was
yeah, I just remember looking at it and it was big and round
yes, I would
the old film one, with scratches and flickering
leave it to you
as you imagine me

it looks right now

okay
